# sherpa-code-block

A monospace code display with a copy button.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Code Block |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-code-block/sherpa-code-block.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-code-block/sherpa-code-block.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-code-block/sherpa-code-block.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-code-block/sherpa-code-block.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-code-block/sherpa-code-block.example.json) |

## When to use it

To show a block of code exactly as written, with a copy button and optional line numbers (`data-line-numbers`). It does no syntax highlighting.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-code-block data-language="javascript" data-line-numbers data-code="const answer = 42;"></sherpa-code-block>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-code` | text |  | the code to show (also settable via the default slot) |
| `data-language` | text |  | a short language label shown in the header (e.g. "bash") |
| `data-line-numbers` | boolean |  | boolean — render a line-number gutter beside the code. Numbers derive from the code's line count; CSS-gated. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | read only |  |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `code-copy` | `{ code: string }` | On a successful clipboard write. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | text | the code, when data-code is not set |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`code`, `code-text`, `copy`, `gutter`, `header`, `language`, `pre`
